# Giridhar Dhatric

> Staff Software Engineer — Cloud-Native Platforms, Distributed Systems, and Workflow Automation.
> Hyderabad, India. Designing cloud-native platforms, distributed systems, and workflow automation.

## Key topics

- Cloud-native platforms and multi-tenant SaaS
- Distributed systems and event-driven architecture
- Workflow orchestration (Flowable / BPMN)
- Java, Spring Boot, and backend engineering
- Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
- Observability (OpenTelemetry, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana)

## Experience

- Staff Software Engineer at Blue Yonder (Mar 2024 – Present): architected a Flowable-based cloud-native workflow platform for 20+ teams on Azure.
- Senior Software Engineer at Deloitte (Feb 2015 – Mar 2021): inventory replenishment and subscription management platforms.
- Software Engineer at Infosys (Oct 2011 – Jan 2015): reusable B2C commerce capabilities on SAP Commerce (Hybris).

## Projects
